The Kybliary Community

An Orthodox community of the Apostolic Tradition in Kybliary. Through shared prayer, spiritual support and acts of mercy, we seek to stand alongside people and renew hope.

01 · About

A Community United in Prayer and Work

At the heart of our community are shared prayer, daily work and brotherly love. Each person is called not only to seek inner peace, but also to support their neighbour and share in their joys and difficulties. Through prayer, obedience and mutual care, our community grows in faith, becoming a place of hope, mercy and spiritual renewal.

ISF · Our mission

Spiritual support, mercy and hope

To stand alongside people through prayer, spiritual support and acts of mercy; to help renew hope and nurture a shared life of faith, love and responsibility.

We seek to offer attentive conversation, prayerful support and the care we are able to provide to those who turn to the community. Spiritual conversations, the social kitchen and hot meals for travellers and visitors bring spiritual life together with practical care for our neighbours.

Hope grows where there is room for prayer, repentance, mercy and human dignity. Shared work and care for our home teach responsibility, while attentiveness to one another helps us put faith into practice in everyday life.

Our values

Principles we seek to follow in prayer, work and our relationships.

01

Prayer

To remain turned towards God amid everyday tasks. To make room for personal and shared prayer, including the evening Rosary.

02

Attentiveness to each person

To listen to one another, respect personal dignity and see more than a person's difficulties. To nurture calm and kind communication.

03

Shared responsibility

To take part in daily duties and the care of our shared home. To notice needs close to us and look after what has been entrusted to the community.

04

Simplicity and mutual support

To recognise the value of ordinary tasks, shared work and time together. To support one another through attention, presence and the contribution each person can make.

The certificate names the Uzhhorod District State Administration of Zakarpattia Region as the registration authority.

The certificate's details were checked against the photograph of the paper document and the register extract. Address and leadership details refer to the dates of those sources; current visiting arrangements are confirmed separately.
